title: Getting Started With Agent Testing: Test Setup and Structuring (part 3)

chapters.title: Test structure and three core components
Configuration file example and code unit reuse
Installation code unit and YAML file loading
Test categorization: P0, P1, load and variation tests
Test runner location and sample availability
Future plans: LLM judge and Visual Studio Code integration
Call to action and feedback request

features.name: AI Development Toolkit Evaluation app
features.description: A new app that provides dependency management and core integration with Business Central UI for agent testing, including AI test toolkits and agent test library utility methods.

features.name: AI Test Toolkits
features.description: Core integration with Business Central UI and agent test library providing utility methods for handling tests and creating test data.

features.name: Test Suite Management methods
features.description: Methods available in the AI test suite management module that handle importing YAML and XML configuration files into the environment.

features.name: Data-driven test structure with YAML
features.description: Test configuration using YAML files for data sets and XML files for test suite configuration, allowing reuse of code units across multiple data sets.

features.name: P0 test category
features.description: Core test category for happy path tests that must succeed most of the time, small focused tests designed to run fast and frequently.

features.name: P1 scenario tests
features.description: Test category for specific scenarios and edge cases, allowing developers to iterate quickly on specific parts of an agent without running all tests.

features.name: Load and variation tests
features.description: Test categories for stress testing agent limits with higher data volumes and for testing agent behavior across different contexts and variations.
caveats: load tests run slower and are executed less frequently

features.name: PowerShell test runner for AL tests
features.description: PowerShell module enabling automated test execution in CI/CD pipelines against sandbox environments with token-based authentication.
caveats: only available for sandbox execution; not supported on on-prem or AL-Go images

features.name: LLM as judge for test validation
features.description: Future feature to verify user intervention text matches expectations and to review generated messages like emails produced by agents.
features.status_evidence_quote: we are planning to introduce LLM as a judge and this one is to verify the user intervention if it is containing the text

features.name: Visual Studio Code test execution
features.description: Planned feature to run AI evaluation suite tests directly from Visual Studio Code.

features.name: Agent-assisted agent implementation
features.description: Planned feature allowing developers to point a development agent at their code to implement Business Central agents with automatic test writing and iterative improvement.
